questions.q: The quarter-wave length at 2.4 GHz is roughly:
questions.explain: λ = c/f = 12.5 cm, a quarter is 3.1 cm.

questions.q: Where does an antenna's gain in dBi come from?
questions.explain: An antenna is passive: gain in some directions means a null in others.

questions.q: Where is the pattern null of a vertical dipole?
questions.explain: The pattern is a “donut”: directly overhead the link is worse.

questions.q: Loss when receiving an RHCP signal with an LHCP antenna:
questions.explain: Opposite directions of rotation mean strong suppression; don't mix them.

questions.q: What does an SWR of 2.0 mean?
options: ~11% of the power is reflected back
Half the power is lost in the cable
questions.explain: SWR 2.0 ≈ −0.5 dB of loss; acceptable, but it heats the VTX.

questions.q: Why shouldn't antennas be hidden under carbon?
options: Carbon is heavy and gets hot

questions.q: Why are the two receiver antennas mounted at 90°?
questions.explain: Diversity: when one is in a null, the other one receives.

questions.q: Which polarization do you choose so that banking doesn't break the video link?
options: Circular (RHCP or LHCP on both ends)
Different on the transmitter and receiver
questions.explain: Circular polarization doesn't depend on how far the antenna is rotated around its axis.
